title: Two first-time PCBs from generated netlists
text: Generates KiCad schematics and board files from a shared netlist with a Python script, validates and exports gerbers by command line, and orders two working boards from a fabricator.

title: Debugging KiCad schematics
text: Edits and debugs KiCad schematics by reading the files and proposing fixes to the circuit.

title: Cheaper BOM and through-hole redesign
text: Swaps parts for cheaper equivalents on a PCB bill of materials, then redoes the schematic with through-hole components so the board can be hand-assembled.

title: KiCad symbols from datasheets
text: Turns uploaded component datasheets into complete KiCad symbols, footprints and sometimes 3D shapes for custom parts.

title: WiFi fan controller on ESP32
text: Designs a KiCad schematic for an ESP32-based WiFi fan speed controller and writes the matching ESP-IDF firmware in one session of about twenty minutes.

title: Board for an unusual microcontroller
text: Answers routing, part selection and fault questions for a new board around an unfamiliar microcontroller and writes its Rust firmware, giving a working board on first power-up.

title: Advice for ESP32 hobby boards
text: Answers schematic, chip, routing and KiCad questions from a newcomer building ESP32 boards, with a second opinion used to catch bad advice.

title: Benchmarking KiCad autorouters
text: Benchmarks several KiCad autorouting tools on a new circuit board design, then the designer picks and tweaks routes and orders a board that works.

title: Arcade button with printed enclosure
text: Builds a battery-powered sound-playing arcade button using a KiCad tool server for the board and a Blender tool server for the enclosure, with trace and header errors remaining.

title: Finishing a board and firmware project
text: Finishes Rust firmware, adjusts components, completes the PCB layout, sources the non-board parts and writes installer documentation for a hardware project.

title: Gerber files and fab ordering guidance
text: Prepares the manufacturing files for a PCB fabricator and explains which options to select in the ordering form.

title: Design review of a finished PCB
text: Reviews a PCB design and the finished board through a KiCad tool server, while routing is still done by hand.

title: OpenSCAD enclosure to STL in minutes
text: Generates an OpenSCAD enclosure design, exports it as STL and sends it to a 3D printer within minutes, then iterates after seeing the first print.

title: Braille dice for blind children
text: Generates OpenSCAD designs for sets of eight-sided dice carrying braille, for a word game for blind children, with screenshots fed back to fix geometry.

title: OpenSCAD puppeteering with screenshots
text: Drives OpenSCAD with a custom tool that renders screenshots and changes camera angles, producing usable designs and inventing new shapes to print.

title: Rope-driven capstan joint for robotics
text: Builds a capstan rope-driven joint for a robot by iterating on OpenSCAD files, then outgrows the workflow and builds a dedicated CAD harness.

title: Parametric parts from sketches
text: Designs printable parts in parametric OpenSCAD from metric dimensions and hand-drawn sketches added to the prompt.

title: Multicolor name tags for Bambu Studio
text: Generates OpenSCAD scripts for multicolor tags where each colour exports as a separate object, so filaments can be assigned in the slicer.

title: Render-and-rotate loop before STL
text: Iterates on an OpenSCAD design by rendering and rotating PNG previews on its own before handing over a finished STL.

title: Stackable desk tray
text: Writes an OpenSCAD file for a stackable desk tray in any size, iterates on small prototypes, and prints three trays within a day.

title: Sixty-part printed project
text: Builds a directory tree of parametric text-based designs per project, with a makefile producing slicer files, and prints a project of sixty parts.

title: Custom project enclosures with CadQuery
text: Writes CadQuery scripts that export STL files and preview images for custom project enclosures, with several printed so far.

title: Functional parts in build123d
text: Keeps a single repository of build123d designs for functional 3D printed parts, with a growing folder of reusable instructions.

title: Gridfinity bases from dimensions
text: Creates Gridfinity storage bases from the stated dimensions of the object to hold, through a CAD tool server, for several printed parts.

title: CadQuery to STEP for Fusion
text: Designs parts in the CadQuery Python library and imports the STEP output into Fusion 360 for final manual changes.

title: Slicer engines running in browser
text: Compiles OrcaSlicer engines to client-side WebAssembly for painting, slicing, assembling and sending prints from a phone-friendly web page.

title: ESPHome sensors for Home Assistant
text: Adds ESPHome configurations and writes drivers for specific sensors, covering a vinyl-audio streaming board and other custom sensors and actuators for a smart home.

title: Embedded driver for unsupported e-paper
text: Writes an embedded Rust driver for an unsupported e-paper display from its specification and existing C drivers, unblocking a stalled project.

title: Remote coding on Pi and ESP32
text: Writes and runs code on a Raspberry Pi over SSH and uploads scripts to an ESP32 through the Arduino command line tool.

title: Analog voltmeter usage gauges
text: Wires old analog DC voltmeters to a microcontroller to show rate limits and CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network load as needle gauges on a desk.

title: Offline speech on ESP32-S3
text: Implements fast 4-bit integer kernels for ESP32-S3 and P4 chips and quantizes speech-to-text and text-to-speech networks to run offline on small boards.

title: Wifi alarm from ESP32 and DFPlayer
text: Builds a wall-mounted wifi alarm from an ESP32, a DFPlayer and an SD card, configured through a web page, to keep a phone out of the bedroom.

title: Ad blocker on an ESP32-C3
text: Writes a network ad-blocking firmware for a tiny ESP32-C3 board, committed almost entirely as generated code.

title: SPICE design loop over ngspice
text: Exposes ngspice simulation as a tool server so a circuit can be loaded from templates with computed component values, simulated for AC, transient and DC, and checked against specs.

title: Oscilloscope check of synth audio
text: Connects to a network-enabled oscilloscope and analyzes the real audio output of a software synthesizer running on a Raspberry Pi Pico.

title: Replica guitar tuners from STEP files
text: Codes a replica of 1760s guitar tuners in build123d, exports STEP files, has them CNC cut, and fits them to an instrument.

title: Bike pump wall mount from photos
text: Tries to design a wall mount for a bike pump in OpenSCAD or CadQuery from photos and a description, and finds no usable results without a simulator.

title: ESP32 dual-core wifi firmware
text: Writes ESP-IDF firmware with wifi and dual-core tasks from detailed do and do-not instructions, fixing errors reported back from the compiler.

title: Tool bridge for embedded boards
text: Wraps PlatformIO in a Rust tool server so coding sessions can build, flash and test on real boards across many processors and toolchains.

title: Analog circuit with LTSpice loops
text: Designs a simple analog circuit and verifies it in LTSpice over three edit, simulate and fix cycles, then exports a poor KiCad schematic.

title: Hardware Buddy port to Pico 2 W
text: Ports a desktop app's Bluetooth hardware companion firmware to a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W with a display, with a build guide and printed case.

title: ESP32 project cases in CadQuery
text: Produces cases for ESP32 projects in CadQuery with a live preview editor, iterating on dimensions through description rather than manual FreeCAD work.

title: Spiking network classifier on FPGA
text: Writes Verilog for a spiking neural network that classifies digits on an ECP5 FPGA over SPI, plus a PC drawing app and RISC-V accelerator changes.

title: E-ink dashboards on reTerminal
text: Flashes e-ink reTerminal screens with ESPHome and writes backends that render custom content, such as rotating daily book quotes with cover art.

title: Desk flight radar on ESP32
text: Turns a cheap ESP32 display into a flight radar that shows nearby air traffic and falls back to usage stats, built on ESPHome with a local voice assistant.

title: Oscilloscope and SPICE closed loop
text: Builds tool servers for an oscilloscope and a SPICE simulator so simulation results can be checked against measurements on the real circuit.

title: Debugging microcontroller faults
text: Debugs basic microcontroller problems from a datasheet and a written description of symptoms, without using the hardware debugger.

title: Complex multi-part assembly in pythonSCAD
text: Produces a complex assembly of several custom parts in pythonSCAD on the first attempt, with functional tests, where plain OpenSCAD failed.

title: Custom firmware for LED matrix
text: Replaces an off-the-shelf Bluetooth LED matrix display's controller with a self-assembled ESP32 and RGBIC matrix running custom firmware.

title: Church tower loft in FreeCAD
text: Writes FreeCAD Python that lofts a square base into an octagonal top, then adds the remaining features of a church tower.

title: Brackets and plates via FreeCAD scripts
text: Generates FreeCAD Python for simple plates and brackets, producing a coherent part sent out for fabrication by someone who cannot use GUI CAD.

title: Meshtastic terminal on Pico 2
text: Builds a portable Meshtastic terminal on a Pico 2 in MicroPython, including an e-ink driver derived from a webcam jig that photographs the screen.

title: RGB-to-RGBW converter on RP2040
text: Writes mostly assembly for an RP2040 RGB-to-RGBW converter and a 1024-LED ESP32 controller, cutting days of work to hours.

title: Fritzing breadboard diagrams
text: Produces Fritzing breadboard wiring diagrams using curved wires to avoid crossings, drawing SVGs for components missing from the library.

title: Parametric CAD driven by scripts
text: Drives a self-built parametric CAD through its command interface to build an engine, a watch and a bicycle from scripts.

title: Build-and-flash loop for STM32
text: Closes the loop of building, flashing and reading results from STM32 hardware through a tool server with scripted command sequences.

title: Printable shapes with slicer config
text: Generates STL files plus matching slicer configuration for a specific printer, using FreeCAD and genetic algorithms to explore mechanisms.

title: Project enclosure attempts across CAD libraries
text: Tries FreeCAD, OpenSCAD and build123d to generate a project enclosure from a detailed requirements list, with frequent failures and wrong features.

title: Ceramics product with scripted 3D work
text: Makes significant changes to custom 3D geometry for a ceramics product through the FreeCAD Python interface.

title: State-machine firmware built with PlatformIO
text: Writes finite-state-machine firmware with PlatformIO from a short spec, wires it up, tests on hardware and keeps the finished device in daily use.

title: Cat food pouch dispenser in CadQuery
text: Designs a dispenser for individual cat food pouches in CadQuery after several false starts, shared as a worked example of code-based CAD.

title: LeCroy scope with SPICE demo
text: Combines a networked oscilloscope with SPICE simulations to compare measured and simulated circuit behaviour in a written demo.

title: KiCad skills for PCB workflow
text: Packages KiCad skills covering PCB design, analysis and fabrication preparation for a terminal coding assistant.
